title: FlowWeaver Workflow v1
description: Canonical shape of Workflow.Nodes and Workflow.Edges. Validated server-side before persisting.

nodes.description: DAG nodes. Must all have unique ids (enforced by the DagParser in Sprint 2).

edges.description: Directed edges between nodes. Source and target must reference existing node ids.

id.description: Stable identifier within the workflow. Used by edges as source/target.

snippet_id.description: UUID of the Snippet this node executes, or a reserved marker.

config_overrides.description: Per-node overrides merged onto the Snippet defaults at run time.

type.description: Optional. Defaults to 'task' when absent. 'subflow' is wired in Sprint 3.

condition.description: Required when type = 'conditional'. Evaluated by the engine's ConditionEvaluator (Sprint 2.7).

source_handle.description: Optional DagNode/SentinelNode handle id on the source side. Purely visual — the engine ignores it. Needed so the frontend can render edges from the exact side the user connected (top/right/bottom/left).

target_handle.description: Optional handle id on the target side. Purely visual — see source_handle.
